findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote_link, get_power_passport_link, list_guides, get_guide, get_builder_upgrade_link · Private data: get_quote_link, get_power_passport_link, get_power_service_quote, route_lead, create_builder_key, get_builder_upgrade_link, find_local_installers, record_quote_review_outcome · Public sink: get_quote_link, route_lead, get_builder_upgrade_link, answer_energy_assessment_question, submit_contractor_match_request · Destructive: run_power_screen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote_link, get_power_passport_link, list_guides, get_guide, get_builder_upgrade_link · Private data: get_quote_link, get_power_passport_link, get_power_service_quote, route_lead, create_builder_key, get_builder_upgrade_link, find_local_installers, record_quote_review_outcome · Public sink: get_quote_link, route_lead, get_builder_upgrade_link, answer_energy_assessment_question, submit_contractor_match_request · Destructive: run_power_screen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
